reason: The cited evidence directly shows that Pd additions and annealing reduce the distribution of exchange energies (E1, E2, E3) and that this correlates with a ~40% refrigerant capacity enhancement (E1, E3). However, the premises that this sharpens the transition, reduces hysteresis, and maintains mechanical stability/heat exchange are not explicitly supported by the cited passages; they are inferred from the homogeneity argument.
premises: Pd additions reduce the distribution of exchange energies in NiFeCoCr-based HEAs
Reduced exchange energy distribution sharpens the second-order magnetic phase transition
Sharper transition enhances low-field magnetocaloric response (refrigerant capacity) by ~40%
Homogeneous microstructure from Pd and annealing maintains mechanical stability and heat exchange
